<translate>
<!--T:5-->
'''Instant Transmission''' lets you teleport by locking onto ki. A quick tap of the key puts you right behind the target you are looking at, which makes it a combat tool as much as a travel one. From level 5 you can also hold the key to warp to masters, party members and other players far away, paying Ki for the trip.
</translate>

<translate>
== Learning it == <!--T:6-->

<!--T:7-->
[[Special:MyLanguage/Goku|Goku]] (Good alignment) and [[Special:MyLanguage/Cell|Cell]] (Evil alignment) teach Instant Transmission.
</translate>

<translate>
== Tap: teleport behind a target == <!--T:11-->

<!--T:12-->
'''Tap''' {{Key|H}} to teleport behind the target you are looking at, within '''25 blocks + 10 per level'''. The target has to be in your line of sight and close to your crosshair; your locked-on target is used when you have one. If several beings are near your crosshair, the one you hit in the last few seconds is chosen first, otherwise the strongest one.

<!--T:13-->
The jump costs Ki (more the farther you go) and shares the '''dash cooldown''' (4 seconds by default), so you can't dash right after it.
</translate>

<translate>
== Hold: the Instant Transmission menu == <!--T:14-->

<!--T:15-->
From '''level 5''', '''hold''' {{Key|H}} for half a second to open the Instant Transmission menu and pick a destination. The menu has two tabs: '''NPCs''' for masters and '''Players''' for everyone else.

<!--T:16-->
* any [[Special:MyLanguage/Masters|master]] whose Ki you have learned, by talking to them at least once;
* your '''party members''';
* other players within '''200 blocks per level''' whose Battle Power is close to yours (between 90% and 125% of it).

<!--T:24-->
Each entry shows a planet icon for the dimension it is in and the Ki the trip costs ('''Ki required'''). Destinations you can't reach are greyed out, and you can't travel if you don't have enough Ki.

<!--T:17-->
From '''level 10''', masters and party members in other dimensions can be reached too. After a warp to a master or a player, Instant Transmission has a 30-second cooldown by default.
</translate>
{{Config|Combat Config|dashCooldownSeconds / teleportCooldownSeconds}}

<translate>
== Ki cost of a warp == <!--T:25-->

<!--T:26-->
A warp from the menu costs Ki:
* a base of '''50 Ki''' (five times the fly-dash cost with the default settings);
* '''5 Ki''' for every full 25 blocks to a destination in the same dimension;
* a '''route fee''' to a destination in another dimension: the difference between the two dimensions' values below. A trip from Earth to Namek costs 2,000 Ki extra, and one from Namek to the Otherworld 18,000.

<!--T:27-->
Warps are free in Creative mode.
</translate>

<translate>
== Who can't be reached == <!--T:18-->

<!--T:19-->
* Upgraded [[Special:MyLanguage/Android|Androids]].
* A [[Special:MyLanguage/Glind|Glind]], whose Divine Ki hides them, unless you are a Glind too, have unlocked a God Form or are under Kami's Blessing.
* A player in a God Form, unless you have godly ki yourself (an unlocked God Form, an active God Form or Divine Ki).
* A player wearing the [[Special:MyLanguage/Anti-Ki Cloaking Device|Anti-Ki Cloaking Device]] (reward of Bulma's Cloaking Device sidequest).
</translate>

<translate>
== Party TP sharing == <!--T:20-->

<!--T:21-->
Party members only receive their share of the Training Points you earn if you know Instant Transmission: they must be in the same dimension and within its range, '''200 blocks per skill level'''. See [[Special:MyLanguage/Training Points and Mastery|Training Points and Mastery]].
</translate>
{{Config|General Server Config|instantTransmissionPlayerRangePerLevel}}

<translate>
== Notes == <!--T:22-->

<!--T:23-->
* While you ride a [[Special:MyLanguage/Space Pod|Space Pod]], {{Key|H}} opens the Space Pod menu instead.
* Before v2.2, [[Special:MyLanguage/Frieza|Frieza]] taught Instant Transmission; it moved to Cell.
</translate>
